description: epoch_to_rfc2822 implements the Rata Die civil-calendar algorithm with single-letter variable names (z, era, doe, yoe, y, doy, mp, d, m). A reader unfamiliar with the algorithm cannot verify the code without looking up the algorithm externally. A comment citing the Euclidean affine functions paper (Howard Hinnant's date algorithms) or howardhinnant.io/date_algorithms.html, plus renaming the most opaque names, would make this self-contained.
title: core: util.rs epoch_to_rfc2822 uses raw arithmetic with opaque variable names (era, doe, yoe, doy, mp)
